**Parent epic:** #278

**Depends on:** #279, #280, #281, #282, #283

## Outcome
One reviewable go/revise/stop decision for #278 and a bounded future implementation handoff, with no implied adoption or execution.

## Gate review
- All five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres preserved; jack and pot front boards remain distinct; protected/feedback/sensitive nodes remain correctly local.
- Complete endpoint/package/rear-terminal ownership; one-zone and adjacent-two mechanics including rear calibration/replacement; whole-path power/reference/return budget and current/load gaps explicit.
- Demonstrable improvement in total wiring/assembly/verification burden versus the limited-change control; if fixed-panel fit, support, burden or electrical constraints fail, revise rear-card location/local connection/boundary rather than continuing automatically.
- No giant motherboard routing until one-zone and adjacent-two gates are accepted. No tool-building milestone alone counts as an engineering decision closed.

## Staged verification specification
1. **Separately authorized one-zone implementation:** source-owned schematic/PCB generation, exact net/Ref-pin parity and full ERC/DRC/warning disposition, power/return completeness, mechanical evidence and source-linked reproducibility. Use pinned KiCad 10.0.6 via repository wrapper when admitted. Missing, capped or partial oracle results are NOT RUN/INCOMPLETE, not PASS.
2. **Separately authorized one physical unit:** final intended components, jack/control/reference/power interfaces and representative harnesses; shared-reference five-receiver-equivalent load. Review safe current-limited/fault tests first. Test rails/VEE5, startup/order/loss/brownout/off-state injection, output load/short recovery; 20-minute warmup, all six trims, five-octave tracking and octave steps, low/high frequency, four waveform amplitude/DC/distortion, FM/PWM, hard/soft sync, drift and service access.
3. **Second independently assembled unit:** repeat calibration/performance, adjacent fit, exchange and simultaneous operation; do not infer repeatability from one unit.
4. **All five and instrument:** shared power/reference/return loading, inter-module interference, thermal/assembly/service behavior and broader acceptance owners.

Existing 5 cents at 25 °C and adjacent octave step 2 mV are targets, not passed results. 0.015–20,000 Hz is a characterization range, not a guaranteed specification. Define unresolved distortion/temperature/performance thresholds before replication.

## Decision record and handoff
Record chosen or rejected alternatives, independent circuit/mechanical reviews, exact input SHAs, justified reuse/invalidated evidence, outstanding risks and owner decisions. Propose allowed front-board redesign, enclosure depth/support bounds, connector/removal choice, effort/prototype budget, and completion-versus-copper-reuse priority. Do not invent cost/time savings. Cost comparison must include exact parts, assembly, harnesses, support/shafts/knobs, calibration and inspection.

Provide a self-contained future prompt with repository/issue links, explicitly selected source/base (do not silently use the stopped PR stack), owned paths, dependency/readiness contracts, check commands and authorization limits. Do not launch a worker or edit decision.json. #253 remains open until its actual acceptance/reconciliation is met; old and physical acceptance issues are not closed by this design decision.

## Execution boundary
Planning deliverable under #278; **not started by issue creation**. Read #278, AGENTS.md and circuit/WORKFLOW.md before later authorized work. No production source/CAD changes, native campaigns, merge, fabrication, ordering or energization under the organization request. Preserve five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres, canonical boards, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Use exact source hashes and distinguish proposal, source/model evidence, native evidence and bench evidence. Missing checks are NOT RUN. Do not restart parked #242/E16 prompts or reopen completed finite-path/552-omission tasks. Keep pre-existing electrical and physical defects open.
